detail:
Full summary: Implemented creation-time provisional (2.5.0, field-requested per 2026-07-23 consumer handoff): status enum on twining_decide + per-decision status on twining_record structured objects, threaded through DecisionEngine.decide to both store create() paths. 1428 tests green.
Decisions: Chose to enforce the two-value creation-status enum in DecisionEngine.decide (TwiningError INVALID_INPUT) in addition to the zod schemas — the test harness bypassing zod exposed that schema-only enforcement let status:'superseded' persist through direct engine callers; lifecycle outcomes must stay uncreatable through every caller; Chose per-decision status on twining_record's structured objects with NL strings always active — per the consumer handoff, deliberately NOT replicating reversible's top-level one-flag-for-all quirk; Chose to verify tool-created decisions via twining_why in integration tests instead of reading decision JSON files — the integration harness resolves to the sqlite backend where per-decision files don't exist
Findings: warning: both new status field descriptions carry the promote_provisionals warning inline per consumer requirement — keep it when editing those descriptions; a stray promote_provisionals:true+execute silently ratifies a week of un-reviewed irreversible provisionals; The reversibility-router charter (analysis/reversibility-router-charter.md, consumer repo) is the waiting consumer for this field — unblocked once 2.5.0 ships
